points: Nova 2026.2 encrypts guest memory with AMD SEV-SNP or Intel TDX via a flavor or image setting
TDX needs 5th-gen Xeon Scalable or later; SEV-SNP enables signed attestation reports
Hosts that enable SEV-SNP will not start SEV-ES instances: migrate them first
take: Open-source private and sovereign clouds can now offer encrypted, attestable VMs natively. Ask your OpenStack-based provider when SEV-SNP or TDX flavors arrive.
title: OpenStack Hibiscus: Nova adds AMD SEV-SNP and Intel TDX confidential VMs
